objective: Add per-OID source-native descriptive statistics to the DR24 Explorer so the Park demonstrator provides useful time-series summaries without applying unapproved normalization, epoch selection, source grouping, feature mapping, or model inference.

previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: A bounded real-data demonstrator may show acquisition, light curves, descriptive analysis, QC, provenance and export while model inference remains blocked.
DR24 HMJD, native magnitude, magerr, clrcoeff, catflags, OID, filter, field and rcid must remain source-native and traceable.
Raw DR24 Explorer is not a classifier. Do not convert HMJD, alter photometry, apply an unapproved flag mask, or merge OIDs.

change.scope: Add a pure descriptive-statistics function for each DR24 OID; attach the summaries to the native DR24 response; display them in the Workbench; retain the full raw payload and existing QC assessment. No classifier, v0.2 feature mapping, time conversion, photometric conversion, catflags selection, or cross-OID grouping is introduced. The raw export envelope is versioned as ztf-dr24-raw-export-v0.3 to account for the additive descriptive_summaries field.
change.rationale: The current DR24 Explorer shows raw curves and QC counts. Per-OID descriptive statistics improve the demonstrator's analytical usefulness while preserving the scientific boundary.

expected_improvement: Show epoch counts, HMJD span, median sampling interval, median magnitude, 5th–95th percentile magnitude range, and median non-negative magerr for each OID.
Make the inclusion and exclusion rules explicit: finite HMJD/magnitude pairs are summarized regardless of catflags; uncertainty statistics are calculated separately.
Keep HMJD and native DR24 photometry unchanged.
Expose that no feature generation, physical-source grouping, or classification was performed.
Version the JSON export contract when adding the derived descriptive-summary section.

correctness.reason: The descriptive summary function and integration are implemented, but correctness is not accepted until exact-head tests pass.

reproducibility.reason: No exact-head live DR24 replay or local Workbench run has been completed.

scientific_validity.reason: This descriptive-only change does not evaluate physical identity, variability features or classifier validity.

measurement.trade_off: This is descriptive analysis only. It does not establish source identity, astrophysical variability, periodicity, feature parity, classifier accuracy, calibration, OOD, or anomaly detection.

evidence: Four deterministic unit tests were added for valid values, missing/invalid values, duplicate HMJD, and per-OID separation.
CI has not yet run on this branch.
No live DR24 query or local Workbench execution was performed by this change.
validation.blocker: The exact-head CI and the pinned live Workbench execution have not yet passed.

root_causes: The current Explorer provides raw plotting and diagnostic QC but no reusable per-OID descriptive time-series summary.
unresolved: Astrophysical source identity remains unresolved for cross-OID associations.
The summary is not a validated variability feature set or model input.

findings: A descriptive summary can be computed without mutating raw epochs.
Magnitude statistics must not use catflags to select or discard epochs unless a separate policy is approved.
HMJD must remain explicitly labelled and must not be presented as MJD.
OID-level summaries do not establish canonical astrophysical source identity.
The raw export schema version is incremented to v0.3 because the export now includes a derived descriptive_summaries section.

open_blockers: Run the new deterministic unit tests and the full CI suite on the exact PR head.
Verify the existing live API and Workbench export contract remains unchanged.
Repeat the pinned live Workbench run on the exact candidate commit.

knowledge_carried_forward: DR24 descriptive summaries use schema ztf-dr24-descriptive-summary-v1 and status DESCRIPTIVE_NOT_CLASSIFICATION.
Every summary is per OID; grouping_applied=false.
No raw epoch is removed, rewritten, or reordered.
Model inference remains BLOCKED until the original model artifact and feature compatibility gates pass.
Raw JSON export schema is ztf-dr24-raw-export-v0.3.
